criteria.requirement: Implement simplejson.pointer.tokens(pointer), index(token,length,*,append=False) and resolve(document,pointer). Support empty root, empty mapping keys and RFC6901 ~0/~1 escapes with exact one-pass semantics. Reject malformed escapes, URI fragments, non-string pointers and non-canonical array indices (negative, leading zero, bool-like, dash except append mode). Mappings keep numeric-looking string keys; arrays use bounds-checked numeric indices. Resolution returns the original referenced value and never mutates the input.
